name: Donald Trump
description: Follow Donald Trump, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: New Limits on Trump’s I.R.S. Deal, and Prosecutors Say Reflecting Pool Work Was ‘Botched’
changes.summary: Plus, why college jerseys suddenly have corporate logos.

changes.title: Israel says it has concerns with Hamas disarmament deal as it keeps up Gaza strikes
changes.summary: Israel says it has shared concerns with the United States about the proposed disarmament deal with Hamas, raising new doubts about the agreement touted by President Donald Trump.

changes.title: Trump claims Iran talks will start Monday, and 4 other developments in the Middle East
changes.summary: U.S. President Donald Trump said new talks to wind down the war in Iran will start Monday, after announcing he is holding off on new massive strikes he had threatened to unleash on the country.

changes.title: NATO spending pressure returned
changes.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche has issued a formal order terminating President Donald Trump's $1.8 billion "anti-weaponization fund" to compensate his political allies.

changes.title: Oil Prices Plummet as Investors Digest Pause in Iran War Fighting
changes.summary: The markets’ moves were the first since President Trump said he had halted a planned U.S. assault on Iran.

changes.title: Trump’s Meddling in Justice Dept. Causes Problems of His Own Making
changes.summary: In the past week alone, President Trump’s interference has imperiled one criminal case, set the stage for sanctions in a second and hindered the confirmation chances of his pick for attorney general.

changes.title: Iran Says No Current Talks With U.S. After Trump Cites Progress on the Strait of Hormuz
changes.summary: President Trump cited progress in the negotiations when canceling a threatened attack on Iran over the weekend. Iran said there were no current talks with the United States.

changes.title: Trump administration weighs proposal to gut Head Start preschool standards, leaving states to set the rules
changes.summary: Two people familiar with the deliberations tell The Associated Press the Republican administration's proposed changes could significantly reduce the preschool program's quality standards.

changes.title: After Colleges Reject ‘Compact,’ Trump Officials Try a Letter
changes.summary: The open letter from Education Secretary Linda McMahon fell far short of the attempt at a compact last year that dangled research money in return for embracing the Trump administration’s agenda.

changes.title: Documents Undercut Trump’s Claims About Bears Ears National Monument
changes.summary: President Trump said recreation in Bears Ears National Monument was virtually impossible. Documents reviewed by The New York Times show officials knew otherwise.
